newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson/Mobifon sign GSM agreement in Romania.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson/Mobifon sign GSM agreement in Romania.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday that in conjunction with Mobifon it has signed a three year frame agreement for delivery of a GSM cellular mobile telephony system in Romania.
Mobifon is a joint venture between TIWC of Canada, AirTouch of the U.S. and five local partners.
The agreement includes deliveries and installation of switching and radio equipment.
The Romanian partners are Posta Romania, Logic Telecom, Ana Electronics, ISAF and the Romanian Investment Fund.
The value of the first phase of the contract covering four months of delivery and installation is more than $15 million, Ericsson said. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
